# transformation parameter

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transformationParameter`](gmeow-transformationParameter.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/transformationParameter>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

An optional parameter qualifying the transformation — e.g. a [`PitchInterval`](../classes/gmeow-PitchInterval.md) for transposition, a [`MetricStructure`](../classes/gmeow-MetricStructure.md) for reaccentuation, or another entity. The exact interpretation is type-dependent and solver-evaluated ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
